title: Lists and batches: INPUT_IS_LIST, OUTPUT_IS_LIST
hook: A batch is one thing to the engine. A list is many, and your node gets called once for each. Mix them up and you get strange pairs or a stuck queue.

verified.claim: A list of 3 made the next node run 3 times, and an INPUT_IS_LIST node then got [0, 10, 20] and its widget as [1] in one call.
verified.ref: V1 and V3 test nodes through PromptExecutor, CPU

verified.claim: In the graph f_list_tiles, ImageInvert ran 4 times on 4 tiles, and the merge node ran once.
verified.ref: graph f_list_tiles with a counter on ImageInvert

verified.claim: A shorter list is padded by repeating its last value, and a batch is one entry in the list.

unchecked: We didn't measure time or memory for a list against a batch of the same images.
